summary: This experimental document defines a hash algorithm with parameters for the Cryptographic Message Syntax (CMS) and S/MIME. Parameterized hashes had not been used in CMS before, and people suspected they could break software. The experiment exists to find out how much trouble such parameters actually cause.

eli5.summary: Nobody had tried hash recipes with extra settings in this email-security format, and some feared it would break things. This document builds one so people can test and see.
